description: This Java class, DefaultTimerBuilder, is a builder for creating and configuring a timer object (PreparedTimer). It guarantees that the timer always starts immediately upon creation and allows adding tags for metrics purposes. It is part of a metrics instrumentation package used for performance monitoring or tracing.

classes.name: DefaultTimerBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and configuring PreparedTimer instances, with methods to add tags and build the timer.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer, overriding any existing tags with the same keys.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer, overriding any existing tag with the same key.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a PreparedTimer instance with the specified name and accumulated tags.
